Title: JavaScript user-defined aggregates in Azure Stream Analytics

Body.Content: Following the release of JavaScript user-defined functions, Azure Stream Analytics now supports JavaScript user-defined aggregates (UDAs). With UDAs, you can run your own stateful computations: time-weighted averages, cumulative density, array cumulation, and much more.
